newsitem.title: UK: Rank poised to sell coach unit to MBO - paper.
newsitem.headline: Rank poised to sell coach unit to MBO - paper.

text.p: The Rank Organisation Plc is near a deal to sell its Shearings coach holiday business to a management buy-out (MBO) team for a bid of around 75 million stg, the Independent on Sunday newspaper reported.
A spokesman for Rank said the company had been in negotiations for some time "with various parties," and the company was "optimistic one will come through shortly."
But he declined to give further details of any talks.
The Independent on Sunday said the MBO bid was led by former Rank director Angus Crichton-Miller and Shearing managing director John Slatcher. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427717
